SSDGchangelog

How this site got the way it is, newest first. The entry says what changed; beside a few, a note says why, in the maker’s hand. “Considered options” opens what else was on the table.

  1. 2026-08-29

    The next-meeting card fits a phone

    The rotation row may wrap; only the four-name chain stays whole. Hanging indents keep wrapped lines under their titles. Measured at 320, 375, 768, and 1200.

  2. 2026-08-29

    September’s stories on the card

    Two title lines, the second hanging so it aligns under the first in the mono face. The block stops saying TBD.

  3. 2026-08-19

    The archive becomes a wall of titles

    Dense titles as the main material; notes and tags collapse behind a click per row, with a “+ all notes” toggle. The ledger on the card gets its newest row.

  4. 2026-08-03

    The library form is the logo

    A date-due card, after a real one JC supplied. The full ASCII card sits in the header; the favicon is the card in five strokes.

    considered options
    • L1Salmon card stock
      Tried on the linslow tile. Rejected: not the card.
    • L2Cream card, thin blue rules, typewriter inkpicked 8/2
      The identity in every site’s footer.
    • F1The full ASCII card in the headerpicked 8/3
      Call number, AUTHOR Various, TITLE Two short stories, monthly. The ledger rows are real sessions.
    “SSDG” alone doesn’t carry the mark at small sizes; the full name on ruled lines does.
    JC, 8/3
  5. 2026-08-02

    Every story gets a reader-facing description

    All sessions rewritten for a reader, not for the group. All Play joins the rotation as its own station.

  6. 2026-08-02

    The index table is generated from the archive

    The sync script rewrites the story table from the vault record. Author cells no longer truncate at a comma; collections are italicized.

  7. 2026-08-01

    The card points at the next picker

    August is an all-play; the arrow moves to JC for September.

  8. 2026-07-02

    Personal news leaves the public notes

    Third-party news and a grief line come out of the public record.

  9. 2026-06-04

    Elsewhere joins the footer

    Links to the other four properties, under the bewilderment prayer.
